usedFor: humanitix holds your events and Asana holds projects, so “New Event Is Created” can run “Create Project” for planning.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event Is Created” in humanitix, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each event you set up in Humanitix gets an Asana project with name, notes and dates ready.

watchOut: “New Event Is Created” in humanitix is polling, so “Create Project” in Asana runs after a scheduled check.
